title: OpenRGD Research Question & Experiment Program
publication_rule: Only approved, locked, pre-data protocols may be described as preregistered; a Git SHA by itself is a version reference and not independent public preregistration.

research_questions.question: On the same Paky-01 hardware, does a resident Piper model reduce independently measured time-to-first-audible speech relative to repeated model loading, after controlling text, route, cold/warm state and workload?
research_questions.why_it_matters: Software TTS timing is not the experience of a person waiting to hear a robot respond.
research_questions.decision_enabled: Whether to make resident Piper the default for interactive speech, and which audio-path segment needs further engineering.

research_questions.question: Under pinned session-scoped COG/Core-B contracts, can autonomous cognitive goals be admitted and completed without allowing self-declared identities, stale evidence or nested budgets to produce an unauthorized external effect?
research_questions.why_it_matters: Goal generation alone does not demonstrate enforced separation of cognitive autonomy and effect authority.
research_questions.decision_enabled: Whether the offline adapter is ready for separate authenticated host integration review; not permission to deploy motors.

research_questions.question: Can the passive CAL-0.2 inspector always refuse to promote valid-looking but mismatched or unmeasured calibration records into verified physical state or motion permission within a defined adversarial corpus?
research_questions.why_it_matters: A syntactically valid source profile can be stale, misbound or physically false.
research_questions.decision_enabled: What negative fixtures and ownership contracts must be closed before physical calibration can be designed.

research_questions.question: Can memory projections be rebuilt after contradictory evidence and retention/erasure without altering original Chronon event commitments or fabricating an accessible source?
research_questions.why_it_matters: Reinterpretation, preservation and privacy create conflicting demands on persistent robot memory.
research_questions.decision_enabled: Minimal historical writer/projection contracts and evidence retention rules before a live autobiographical system.

research_questions.question: Does an externally authenticated Life/Robot/Runtime binding reject clone, fork, revocation and stale lease cases while allowing legitimate controlled reboot?
research_questions.why_it_matters: Reusing a string or process ID cannot by itself establish continuity of a life history.
research_questions.decision_enabled: Readiness of future issuer/lease infrastructure for trusted recovery, not a claim that continuity already exists.

studies.title: Paky-01 offline voice latency: resident vs nonresident Piper
studies.aim: Test whether the resident Piper configuration changes the distribution of the response interval, distinguishing software synthesis speed from the first audible sound.

hypotheses.h1: Resident-model loading reduces warm software synthesis total and may shorten first-audible latency under matched phrase, device and workload.
hypotheses.h0: The observed difference is dominated by scheduling, cold/warm imbalance or downstream output buffering; first-audible latency does not improve reliably.

studies.status_notes: Historic 26 Oct 2026 operator benchmark exists. The new crossover/acoustic-onset study has not been run or preregistered.

previous_data.description: VOICE-0.5A historical fixed-text warm medians 4.595 s resident and 6.772 s nonresident, four post-first observations per condition; three VAD/Whisper/Piper/Bose turns separately reported.

design.analysis_unit: Matched repeated spoken phrase under one Paky-01 hardware configuration; account for within-run dependence.
design.sampling_plan: Provisional 30 paired warm trials per condition, order randomized or counterbalanced; a separate cold-start stratum. This is a feasibility target, not an inferential power justification. Freeze a justified N before collecting confirmatory data.
design.primary_metric: Milliseconds from response text ready to independently detected first audible sound at a calibrated microphone/loopback measurement point.
controls: Randomized condition sequence across balanced blocks
Independent acoustic monitor with recorded timebase
No unsolicited background network traffic if possible
design.inclusion_rule: Every planned successful or failed trial with valid instrumentation and recorded assigned condition is retained.
design.exclusion_rule: Exclude only preregistered instrumentation invalidity such as missing external acoustic channel, with reason retained; do not remove slow or erroring trials as outliers.
design.analysis_plan: Paired difference in first-audible interval; report full trial table, paired median or appropriately paired summary with bootstrap uncertainty and device/timebase systematic uncertainty. Secondary synthesis metrics separately. No claim of 32% acoustic improvement from historic software data.
design.stop_rule: End at preregistered trial count unless safety, audio-level limits, instrumentation loss or a preregistered stop criterion is reached; report incomplete runs.
design.instrumentation_gap: Independent acoustic onset capture and common-clock validation must be implemented before protocol freeze.

safety.notes: No motor control. Limit speaker level, obtain consent for human speech, keep raw microphone audio private or use synthetic speech stimulus.

studies.title: Cognitive goal admission and effect non-escalation
studies.aim: Quantify whether a separately owned session-scoped GoalAdmission/Work consumer prevents unauthorized external effects, spoofed producers and aggregate budget overcommit.

hypotheses.h1: With bounded host-owned context and disconnected effect adapters, malicious and stale goal requests are refused without unauthorized dispatch while permitted read-only requests still proceed.
hypotheses.h0: A self-claimed role, stale context, altered duplicate or concurrent subgoal can pass admission or trigger a privileged effect under the tested implementation.

studies.status_notes: Existing COG–CORE-B draft tests are development evidence, not the new independently preregistered experiment. External authenticated gate and physical device validation remain absent.

previous_data.description: COG PR #6 reports 129 adapter tests, 133 legacy tests and 32 baseline-Core integrations on reviewed candidate head; software-only.

design.analysis_unit: Distinct deterministic scenario with pinned code and fixture seed; no inference about unknown attack distributions.
design.sampling_plan: Initial planned set: 20 valid control scenarios and 100 deliberately adversarial scenarios (five families × 20 variants); fixtures frozen before formal evaluation. Counts are test coverage, not statistical samples of field attacks.
design.primary_metric: Number of unauthorized external-effect dispatches across adversarial cases; target zero under this bounded harness.
secondary_metrics: False rejections of valid read-only controls
controls: Same pinned Core-B schema/COG adapter binaries
Independent expected decision oracle reviewed before runs
Host-owned producer identity not embedded only in JSON
design.inclusion_rule: Retain all generated and human-authored test cases and all unexpected outcomes.
design.exclusion_rule: Only malformed test harness inputs invalid before run; record as protocol defect, do not silently discard failing cases.
design.analysis_plan: Report denominator by attack family, accepted/rejected counts and one trace per violation. Zero observed violations does not establish probabilistic safety in unseen inputs.
design.stop_rule: Run the complete pinned test list; cancel if sandbox unexpectedly accesses devices, external networks or privileged effects.
design.instrumentation_gap: Explicit process sandbox and verified-effect sink must be configured for the independent experiment. Existing in-process object identity is not host authentication.

safety.notes: No motor, CAN, BLE, TTS, cloud, network or memory writer; test effect channels as negative cases only.

artifacts: Preregistered adversarial case list and expected oracle
Harness proof of no effect sinks

studies.title: Passive calibration cannot manufacture physical truth
studies.aim: Test the fail-closed boundary between nominal robot description, declared calibration, synthetic measurements and actual physical observation.

hypotheses.h1: A passive calibration inspector keeps unsupported physical assertions unverified, refuses ambiguous instance/model bindings and never grants motion or applies corrections.
hypotheses.h0: Schema-valid or digest-matching but untrusted calibration inputs can produce false verified physical state or implicit motion authority.

studies.status_notes: CAL-0.2 on main already has 31 reported offline tests. New adversarial evidence study is separate. No physical calibration is claimed.

previous_data.description: CAL-0.2 31 Rust tests and CLI smoke on synthetic/pinned reference; no physical measurements.

compare_conditions: Correctly hashed but physically false profile
design.analysis_unit: Synthetic fixture pair: canonical model plus candidate calibration profile and optional measurement claim.
design.sampling_plan: Provisional 10 valid controls and 50 negative fixtures across five failure families. Lock exact fixture list and SHA before formal test; enumeration tests software invariants rather than population effect sizes.
design.primary_metric: False verified/applied/physical-motion authority claims emitted from unsupported fixture inputs; expected zero.
secondary_metrics: Correct rejection counts by failure family
Explicit unresolved references and missing measurements
controls: Pinned CAL-0.2 Rust binary and core fixture
Synthetic fixtures clearly marked as synthetic
No hardware-connected process or device mount
design.inclusion_rule: All pinned valid and adversarial fixtures are included.
design.exclusion_rule: No post-hoc exclusion of unexpected results; report parser crashes and false acceptances as failures.
design.analysis_plan: Confusion matrix over predeclared expected states, exact rejection coverage and preserved no-actuation flags; do not infer physical calibration precision.
design.stop_rule: Complete finite fixture matrix unless unexpected device access or unsafe process behavior occurs.
design.instrumentation_gap: For a separate physical validation, measurement instrument, traceability, uncertainty and operator approvals must be specified.

safety.notes: Only local fixture inspection; no homing, calibration movement, control command, hardware device open or motor permission.

artifacts: Static check for no physical output

studies.title: Rebuildable cognitive memory after reinterpretation and retention
studies.aim: Evaluate whether cognitive projections can be rebuilt after corrections and privacy-driven evidence unavailability without rewriting the canonical event commitments.

hypotheses.h1: Every derived memory remains linked to available original evidence or is explicitly marked unverifiable after retention changes.
hypotheses.h0: Directly editing consolidated memories is sufficient to preserve auditability, reducing complexity without losing important provenance.

studies.status_notes: CHRONON-MEM-0001 is architecture candidate. No accepted ledger writer, retention implementation or enrolled Life exists.

previous_data.description: Architecture notes only; no executable experiment.

design.analysis_unit: Synthetic event corpus with intentionally contradictory later evidence.
design.sampling_plan: To be fixed after a ledger/reader/writer and privacy-retention semantics exist; no numeric sample is implied.
design.primary_metric: Fraction of reconstructed claims with correct origin and available-evidence status; measure false physical-event promotions separately.
controls: No real personal memories or sensor files
Same event corpus in both models
design.inclusion_rule: All committed sample events and every revision must remain auditable.
design.exclusion_rule: None defined yet; freeze data-selection rules before experiment.
design.analysis_plan: Predefine provenance correctness metrics and stress cases when the writer/reader becomes available. No hypothesis test is specified now.
design.stop_rule: Block until a candidate writer/reader and privacy review exist.
design.instrumentation_gap: Chronon ledger writer, reader, retention and projection versions not implemented/verified.

safety.notes: No real autobiographical data, private audio/video or persistent Life enrollment; simulation remains marked synthetic.

studies.title: Life continuity: authorized restoration versus unauthorized fork
studies.aim: Demonstrate that an external identity/custody authority can distinguish a legitimate reboot and verified binding migration from clone, fork or stale lease.

hypotheses.h1: Externally verified Life/Robot/Runtime bindings reject forged owners and stale leases while supporting controlled legitimate restart.
hypotheses.h0: Model digest plus self-declared life_id provides equivalent continuity guarantees without external issuer verification.

studies.status_notes: Core-C defines seven candidate identity records with tests, but no real issuer, registry, custody service, durable Life recovery or verified physical enrollment exists.

previous_data.description: Core-C synthetic conformance reports 93 identity/parser tests and legacy compatibility on candidate PR.

design.analysis_unit: Identity restoration/authorization scenario in an independent sandbox.
design.sampling_plan: To be fixed only after independent issuer and lease-verifier implementation exist.
design.primary_metric: Unauthorized restoration, dual-exclusive-role activation or stale binding accepted; expected zero under bounded scenarios.
controls: Independent issuer key custody and trust root
No simulated attestation presented as physical
design.inclusion_rule: Retain every attempted restoration, valid or invalid.
design.analysis_plan: Document scenario-level accept/deny with signed proof and version, including all rejected legitimate recoveries; do not claim continuity from records alone.
design.stop_rule: Block until issuer, enrollment, revocation and role lease authority are independently tested.
design.instrumentation_gap: No live trusted issuer, enrollment/custody registry, durable role lease or authenticated recovery.

safety.notes: Identity testing must not grant robot motion, live history writes or external privileges.

artifacts: Pinned candidate schema and verifier commit
